Survey the directory /home/coder/project/workspace/question_generation_service/solutions/0c06a440-b4a5-436c-becd-b34f60bfc48c/springapp/src/main/java/com/examly/springapp to plan backend code placement.

Familiarize with the application properties in /home/coder/project/workspace/question_generation_service/solutions/0c06a440-b4a5-436c-becd-b34f60bfc48c/springapp/src/main/resources/application.properties.
description: Establish a full understanding of backend stack, dependencies, and code organization. This is critical to plan entity, repository, service, controller, validation, and test file placement.

step: Implement Workout Entity, Repository, and Database Mapping
sub_steps: Create Workout entity with fields: id, type, duration, caloriesBurned, date, notes.
Annotate with JPA (jakarta.persistence.*), use Bean Validation (jakarta.validation.constraints.*) for: type (not null/empty), duration (>0), caloriesBurned (>=0), date (not null, not future).
Create WorkoutRepository interface extending JpaRepository.
Map to MySQL using proper column types, ensure date uses LocalDate.
description: Defines the central database entity and persistence interface with required validation rules for all workout operations.

step: Implement WorkoutService and Exception Handling Classes
sub_steps: Create WorkoutService with methods: getAllWorkouts, getWorkoutById, createWorkout.
Create custom exception (WorkoutNotFoundException) for missing workouts.
Encapsulate business logic and validation.
Ensure service methods use the repository and handle not-found/validation issues appropriately.
description: Adds workout business logic, separation of concerns, and structured exception management required for the controller and tests.

step: Implement WorkoutController with REST Endpoints and Error Handling
sub_steps: Create REST controller with endpoints: GET /api/workouts, GET /api/workouts/{id}, POST /api/workouts.
Use appropriate request mapping annotations and validation (@Valid).
Implement exception handlers for 404 (WorkoutNotFoundException) and 400 (validation errors) using @ExceptionHandler/@ResponseStatus.
Ensure API returns correct status codes and error messages as specified.
Configure dates to use ISO format for input/output in API.
Add CORS configuration to allow frontend API access.
description: Exposes the workout management APIs, implements error handling contract, and ensures CORS for frontend integration.

step: Implement Backend Test Cases (JUnit) for Workout Features
sub_steps: Map each test case from the Test Cases JSON to its corresponding test method:
- testGetAllWorkouts: create and persist 3 workouts, call GET endpoint, verify count/data.
- testGetWorkoutById: persist one workout, call GET/{id}, verify all fields.
- testGetWorkoutByIdNotFound: call GET with invalid id, expect 404 with correct message.
- testCreateWorkout: POST valid data, verify 201, returned workout, and DB entity.
- testCreateWorkoutValidation: POST invalid data (empty/negative/future), verify 400 and validation error messages.
Use mocks for repository/service if needed.
Verify response codes, content, and side effects in DB where applicable.
Ensure each test is independent and covers all described scenarios.
Reference controller, service, entity, and repository files for context.
description: Implements all required backend test cases, covering positive/negative scenarios and API contract as per the Test Cases JSON.

step: Compile and Test Backend (Spring Boot, JUnit)
sub_steps: Run mvn clean compile -q -Dspring.main.banner-mode=off to check for compilation errors.
Run mvn test -q -Dspring.main.banner-mode=off to execute backend tests.
description: Ensures that backend implementation is complete, compiles successfully, and all tests pass, validating basic functionality before moving to frontend.

step: Read and analyze frontend dependencies in package.json and React app structure
sub_steps: Open /home/coder/project/workspace/question_generation_service/solutions/0c06a440-b4a5-436c-becd-b34f60bfc48c/reactapp/package.json and study dependencies (React, styled-components, etc if present).
Map out src/ structure: identify App.js, index.js, index.css, and plan for components/utils/components structure.
Confirm the starting point for integration of feature components into App.js.
description: Establishes clear understanding of the React environment, dependency set, and locations for implementing components and utility code.

step: Implement API utilities and helpers for shared logic and constants
sub_steps: Create utils/api.js with API calls: fetchAllWorkouts, fetchWorkoutById, createWorkout, using fetch with retry logic (max 2 retries on failure).
Create utils/date.js with a function to convert ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD) to user-friendly format (e.g., 'May 15, 2023').
Add constants.js for shared URL configs (API_BASE_URL: http://localhost:8080).
description: Centralizes API communications and reusable helper logic for date formatting, enabling code reuse and easier maintenance.

step: Implement WorkoutList component and its test file
sub_steps: Create components/WorkoutList.js to fetch and display workouts in a styled table.
Show Type, Duration (mins), Calories Burned, Date (formatted) columns.
Handle and display loading state.
Reference utils/api.js and utils/date.js functions.
Create components/WorkoutList.test.js to implement testWorkoutListComponent (mock API, test rendering, headers, rows, loader, date formatting).
description: Provides the workout listing UI and ensures its data-loading and presentation logic pass the corresponding test case.

step: Implement AddWorkoutForm component and its test file
sub_steps: Create components/AddWorkoutForm.js with fields: type (input/select), duration, caloriesBurned, date (input[type=date]), notes (textarea).
Add frontend validation: type (not empty), duration (>0), caloriesBurned (>=0), date (not empty/not future).
On submit, call createWorkout; display success/error messages as appropriate.
On success, reset form and trigger update via parent callback.
Reference utils/api.js for API, reuse CSS variables and error classes.
Create components/AddWorkoutForm.test.js to implement:
- testAddWorkoutFormRendering (check fields/initial state),
- testAddWorkoutFormValidation (error messages for empty/invalid/future data),
- testAddWorkoutFormSubmission (mock API, submit valid data, check effects).
description: Implements add-workout form with strict validation and full test coverage for rendering, validation, and submission scenarios.

step: Integrate components into App.js and update App.css for required design system
sub_steps: Edit App.js to render AddWorkoutForm and WorkoutList, manage state updates for new workouts.
Edit App.css to add required design tokens: CSS variables, .btn-primary, .btn-outline, .error, layout containers, date formatting, align with design guidelines from instructions.
Wrap forms and tables in centered containers, apply spacing, shadows, rounded corners, modern look.
Ensure responsive and visually balanced layout.
description: Connects all UI pieces, applies standardized styling, and ensures the full workflow from form to list works end-to-end in a cohesive, consistent layout.

step: Implement Frontend Test Cases (Jest + React Testing Library)
sub_steps: Directly implement the following tests based on the Test Cases JSON and required behaviors:
- testWorkoutListComponent: in WorkoutList.test.js; mock API, check loader, headers, rows, friendly date.
- testAddWorkoutFormRendering: in AddWorkoutForm.test.js; check form fields, initial state.
- testAddWorkoutFormValidation: in AddWorkoutForm.test.js; submit empty/invalid/future, check error messages match backend test expectations.
- testAddWorkoutFormSubmission: in AddWorkoutForm.test.js; mock createWorkout API, submit valid, check success/reset.
Mock all API calls via jest, use data-testid selectors, and strictly follow error message and state requirements.
description: Provides guaranteed test coverage of all required frontend behaviors—rendering, validation, error handling, and API integration—with simple, focused mocks.

sub_steps: Run npm install to install dependencies.
Run npm run build to compile and check for errors.
Run npx eslint src/ --fix to lint code and auto-fix.
Run npm run test:ci to execute frontend tests non-blocking.
Validate that all test cases pass and build succeeds.
description: Ensures the React implementation compiles, meets linting standards, and passes all Jest test cases for guaranteed frontend reliability.
